preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The size of the array N must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= A[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each element in the array A must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be a string of two numbers separated by a space, representing the index of rotation and the maximum number of inversions.
The index of rotation must be a valid index within the bounds of the array.
The maximum number of inversions must be non-negative.
